description: One-launch fixed-shape BF16 RMSNorm2, paired W1/W2, and SwiGLU boundary for GDN-2 decode.

hidden.initialization: NaN poison; every element must be overwritten.

domain.layout: Each of 97 contiguous weight items contains 64 original BF16 W1 rows followed by the corresponding 64 W2 rows. Two vector subblocks publish disjoint 1152-element normalized-input halves to L1.
domain.precision: RMS reduction/affine and cube accumulation are FP32. The normalized input, GEMV output, SiLU output and final multiply output each materialize as BF16, preserving the vendor composition's observable boundaries.
domain.ownership: 28 cube groups own disjoint output-item ranges. Both vector subblocks redundantly reduce RMS and own disjoint K halves for V2C. Vector subblock zero consumes both paired W1/W2 halves through a depth-two C2V handoff.
domain.aliasing: Inputs are read-only and hidden is a fresh complete-overwrite output.

default.reason: CCE RMS reduction order and native exponential may differ from the independent CPU expression even though all BF16 materialization boundaries are retained.

measured.static: Conservative-boundary rewrite: pinned Ascriptor 0.1.0 verifier has zero errors/warnings and lowered event balance is empty.
measured.simulation: Reference 2/2 passed. Random functional sim and lowered pipesim both passed with relative-L2 3.416e-7 and max_abs_diff 1.526e-5; pipesim has no hazard/deadlock and models 672723 cycles.
measured.rejected_gamma_fold_predecessor: The prior gamma-fold/FP32-epilogue probe was 1.0772x faster at the isolated boundary, but real-95B four-token recurrence reached logits/recurrent relative-L2 1.037e-2/1.523e-2 and was rejected. This rewrite removes gamma folding and restores normalized-input, GEMV-output and SiLU-output BF16 boundaries.

provenance.source: GDN-2 released RMSNorm and SwiGLU semantics
provenance.disposition: The fixed-shape formula and paired weight layout were independently implemented; no upstream kernel source was copied.

release_scope.note: Repository-owned model-specific inference unit; B=T=1 only.
